consistency_note: No POV exists. Daytime-overcast is the one coherent look: BTS departure (27 s), street under the viaduct (12.6 s, fisheye), traffic timelapse + motorbike junction (14 s), drone skyline (19 s) - about 72 s, all grey tropical daylight, though mixing fisheye, timelapse and real-time. The two night clips (14 s) are a separate suburban Nonthaburi drone shoot and do not match anything else. Season is not judgeable (evergreen tropical city).
sourcing_note: Hard. Web search restricted to pexels.com kept returning the same five Bangkok video pages; most hits were photo pages. Useful terms: 'Bangkok BTS Skytrain', 'Bangkok sky train passing city', 'Bangkok aerial drone skytrain'. Queries for a view from inside a BTS/MRT/SRT train, MRT (underground), Hua Lamphong / Krung Thep Aphiwat mainline trains, and Chinatown/tuk-tuk night video returned no matching video pages - generic 'train window' and 'metro' results were Malaysia, Japan, Paris, Dubai and North America. Wat Arun / Chao Phraya / Iconsiam videos exist on Pexels by listing but all have ids above ~21 million, which fetch_pexels.sh cannot resolve, so none could be viewed or counted. Two counted clips were found by probing ids adjacent to confirmed ones. The repo sheet.sh fails on this machine's ffmpeg (pad filter error); sheets were made with an equivalent script kept outside the repo and saved as work/audit/bangkok/sheet_1..4.jpg.
